page.title: Terminal 1: Mogswamp Edition
page.subtitle: Reimagining the future.
page.heroDescription: A Mogswamp twist on Terminal 1, a retro-futuristic reimagining of the personal gaming computer. Every panel is UV-printed directly onto the chassis: a permanent, precise finish giving the control panel its crisp details and the body a seamless, factory-grade feel that won’t peel, fade, or lift over time.
page.about: A machine that bridges eras and paints a picture of a future that never came. Boxy and ultra-minimal in form, softened by rounded windows inspired by midcentury industrial design.

content.title: Mogswamp Special Edition
content.description: Developed in collaboration with Mogswamp, this edition reimagines Terminal 1 in cool bluish-green tones that leans into a more a playful, retro-console inspired aesthetic.

content.title: The Future Reimagined
content.description: The future imagined through the lens of the past. Every detail nods to the golden age of tech design and early computing, from the iconic green terminal glow to the boxy silhouettes and restrained, minimal palettes of early machines.

content.title: Green Screen Revival
content.description: Paying homage to the monochrome monitors that started it all, Terminal 1 features a printed green control panel detailed with tiny text and interface glyphs with playful references tucked beneath its technical veneer for those who still read the fine print.

content.title: UV Printed Precision
content.description: Every panel on Terminal 1 is UV-printed directly onto the chassis. The result is a seamless, permanent finish giving the control panel its crisp precision and the body a seamless, factory-grade feel that won’t peel, fade, or lift over time.

items.title: Proven Performance
items.description: Every Ironside PC is carefully built to deliver balanced, reliable performance for gaming, creative work, and everyday tasks. Each system undergoes extended testing to ensure stability and longevity, even after years of intense usage.

items.title: Backed by Warranty
items.description: We stand behind our gaming computers with an unrivaled, 3 year parts and lifetime labor Ironside Warranty at no additional charge.

items.title: Shipped with Care
items.description: Every Ironside PC is carefully packaged to arrive safely at your door. We use double boxing and custom internal packaging to keep components secure during transit, so your system arrives exactly as intended.

items.title: Built by Family. Powered by Passion.
items.description: We’re more than a gaming PC company. We’re a family. Founded by four siblings, Ironside has always been a personal project, built with love, care, and respect for craftsmanship. What started in a Las Vegas garage is now a company still run with the same hands-on spirit and attention to detail.
